questions.message: A full-time employee with less than 3 years’ service receives 27 days of annual leave, plus 8 bank holidays. [1]
Report by 09:30 on the first day of absence. [1][2] Shift and on-call workers must report at least 1 hour before their shift or rota period starts. [1][2]

Submit an expense claim within 30 calendar days of when the expense was incurred. [1][2] For a multi-day trip, submit all expenses together within 30 calendar days of the trip’s first expense; leavers must submit claims within 10 working days after their leaving date. [2]
citations: NDS-HR-HB-001 12.3 Claim deadline and late claims

questions.message: No. A holiday request isn’t approved unless PeopleHub shows “Approved.” [1] Your manager must decide within 5 working days; if they don’t, PeopleHub escalates it to the Head of Department, but the request still isn’t approved by default. [2]
citations: NDS-HR-HB-001 6.6 Requesting leave and minimum notice
NDS-HR-HB-001 6.7 Manager response, team coverage and critical delivery periods

questions.message: You can report suspected misconduct to your line manager, People Operations, or through the whistleblowing procedure. [1] You can also contact the Head of Risk and Compliance at compliance@northstar.example, email speakup@northstar.example, or use the independent Speak Up line. [2] The Speak Up line accepts anonymous reports. [2] If you ask for your identity to be protected, Northstar will protect it unless disclosure is required by law. [3]
citations: NDS-HR-HB-001 16.3 How to raise a concern
NDS-HR-HB-001 16.5 Confidentiality and protection from retaliation

questions.message: Yes. If you expect to have responsibility for your child’s upbringing, you can take up to 2 weeks of paternity leave, even though you joined recently. [1] Because you joined only 2 months before the due date, you won’t meet the 26-week service requirement for Statutory Paternity Pay, so the leave will be unpaid; you may use annual leave instead for some or all of it. [1]

You must qualify for Statutory Maternity Pay and have at least 26 weeks’ continuous service at the end of the 15th week before your expected week of childbirth. [1]

- Weeks 1–16: full basic pay, inclusive of SMP. [1]
- Weeks 17–39: SMP only. [1]
- Weeks 40–52: unpaid. [1]

If you do not return to work for at least 6 months after maternity leave, you must repay the enhanced amount above SMP, unless an exception applies for redundancy, ill-health capability, or immediately following statutory family leave. [1]

Yes, assuming your service continues, you’ll have about 5 years and 2 months of service by then, and a 2-month sabbatical is within the 1–3 month range. [1][2] Apply at least 3 months before the start date; approval is discretionary and depends on business needs. [1]

Not for work involving Restricted data by default. You may work from Italy only on tasks that don’t involve it; accessing it requires written CISO approval and permission under the customer contract. Your manager should arrange UK-based cover for Restricted tasks. [1][2][3]
You also need to submit a request at least 4 weeks before travel and get approval from your line manager, People Operations and IT Security; Italy must not be on the restricted-destination list. [2][3]
citations: NDS-HR-HB-001 10.8 Working overseas and cross-border working

questions.message: The policy doesn’t say what happens to approved leave booked after your last day. Please check with People Operations.

Possibly, but leave during a published critical delivery period requires approval from both your line manager and Head of Department, and is normally approved only in exceptional circumstances. [1][2] Leave approved before the period was published remains approved. [1][2]

NDS-HR-HB-001 6.7 Manager response, team coverage and critical delivery periods

It depends on their length of service:
- Less than 3 years: **191.75 hours**.[1][2]
- 3 to less than 5 years: **198.5 hours**.[3][2]

You have 24 working days’ notice, so you meet the 10-working-day minimum for 5 days of leave. [1] Since you’ve passed probation, you may book your full annual entitlement in advance. [2]

With 3 years’ service and probation completed, you can receive 8 weeks at full pay, then 8 weeks at half pay in any rolling 12-month period, if your contract includes the company sick pay scheme. [1] This includes SSP; company sick pay already received in that period is deducted, and reporting or evidence requirements apply. [1]

questions.message: Yes. The £35 taxi is within the £50 limit, and carrying demo hardware is a qualifying reason. Keep the receipt and note the equipment on your claim. [1][2]

Yes, if you have parental responsibility for your daughter; employees are eligible from day one for unpaid parental leave for a child under 18. Being named on her birth certificate is one way to qualify. [1][2]
You need to give 2 months’ notice. Your individual employment contract prevails if it sets a different notice period. [1]

You can work from Spain for 3 days only with prior approval. Submit a PeopleHub Work From Abroad request at least 4 weeks before; your line manager, People Operations and IT Security must approve it, and Spain must not be on the restricted-destination list. You must also not be serving notice. [1]

The 3 days count toward the 10-working-day rolling 12-month limit. You must be available during UK core hours (10:00–16:00); Restricted information requires written CISO approval and customer-contract permission. [1] Working on holiday abroad without approval breaches the policy. [2]
